configuration.transport: dual-rail SIRCL for admitted TP collectives; patched NCCL 2.30.7 otherwise

image_construction.details: The in-image verifier matched 374 B12X source files, the vLLM and SparkCache manifests, 15 retained vLLM native extensions, the SparkCache CUDA libraries, the embedded SIRCL bundle, and patched NCCL.

registry_pull.details: All four ranks pulled the immutable registry digest and resolved it to image ID sha256:5e32aaa1bbe3559e81db7706ed4286248f18d27cfdb186f6b851bf786eb43075.

tp4_start.details: Every rank accepted the SIRCL capability vote; B12X KDA, sparse MLA, NVFP4 MoE, CUDA graphs, DFlash2, and SparkCache initialized; rank zero served HTTP health successfully.

persistent_restore.details: The deterministic prompt entry was written before restart and restored by the exact registry image after restart.

concurrent_store_ownership.details: One 129K-class request followed by eight concurrent 4K-class requests completed. Running requests, waiting requests, delayed ownership, retained pages, and uncertain ranks returned to zero.

sircl_failure_containment.details: Separate test-only builds forced fused device poison and rank-2 proxy exit. No API became ready and the four worker groups stopped without a post-failure collective hang.

limitations: The recorded latency samples are functional evidence, not a broad performance benchmark.
The failure-injection builds are test-only artifacts and are not included in the published image.
DCP1 and DCP2 use the same image but require their own launch and cache namespaces; this receipt records DCP4 serving.
